links.outcome: Medical errors in AI scribe versus conventional documentation, reviewed by the surgeon
links.effect: 19 medical errors in the AI scribe group vs 9 in the conventional group; no significant difference in spelling or grammatical errors.
links.quote: There were 19 medical errors in the AI scribe group compared to only nine errors in the conventional group.

links.outcome: Physician and administrative documentation processing time with AI scribe versus conventional methods
links.effect: Statistically significant reduction in both physician and administrative processing times (P < 0.0001).
links.quote: Use of AI scribes resulted in a statistically significant reduction in both physician and administrative processing times (P < 0.0001).

links.outcome: Patient perceptions of AI scribe use
links.effect: Patients were not negatively affected by AI scribe use and the vast majority found it helpful (no numbers given in abstract).
links.quote: Patients were not negatively affected by using an AI scribe, and the vast majority found it helpful.
